title: China tightens overseas travel controls for citizens via exit bans and fines in a sweeping new law, as Beijing moves to secure state secrets and advanced tech (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: China tightens overseas travel controls for citizens via exit bans and fines in a sweeping new law, as Beijing moves to secure state secrets and advanced tech — President Xi Jinping steps up efforts to secure state secrets, advanced technology and highly skilled workers
